---
title: "{{title}}"
params:
  id: "{{id}}"
---

```{r setup}
library(fhperf)
built <- readRDS(file.path(if (file.exists("_data/indicators.rds")) "." else "..", "_data", "indicators.rds"))
id <- params$id
cat <- built$catalogue
comp <- get_component(cat, id)
x <- built$components[[id]]$series
m <- attr(x, "indicator")
ct <- component_table(cat)
used <- strsplit(ct$used_by[ct$id == id], ", ", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
used_text <- paste(gsub("^([a-z]+_[0-9]{3}) \\((.*)\\)$", "[`\\1`](../indicators/\\1.qmd) (\\2)", used), collapse = ", ")
kind_text <- if (comp$snapshot) "the position on each snapshot date" else paste("one row per event,", comp$aggregate, if (!is.null(comp$unit)) paste("of", comp$unit))
```

`r comp$description`

A component: `r kind_text`, charted here as a `r if (comp$snapshot) "stock" else "count"` by month. Used by `r used_text`.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## SPC

```{r chart}
#| fig-alt: !expr paste("SPC chart of", comp$title)
plot_indicator(x)
```

## By financial year

```{r seasons}
#| fig-alt: !expr paste("One line per financial year, April to March, for", comp$title)
plot_indicator_seasons(x)
```

## 6-12

```{r sixtwelve}
#| fig-alt: !expr paste("The last six weeks and twelve months of", comp$title, "against a year earlier")
plot_six_twelve(built$components[[id]]$six_twelve)
```

:::

## Definition

```{r definition}
#| results: asis
cat("- **Id:** `", id, "` (domain `", id_domain(id), "`, ", cat$domains[[id_domain(id)]]$title, ") &middot; [YAML](../yaml.qmd#yaml-", id, ")\n", sep = "")
cat("- **Aggregate:** ", comp$aggregate, if (!is.null(comp$unit)) paste0(" of ", comp$unit), if (comp$snapshot) " (snapshot)", "\n", sep = "")
if (!is.null(comp$source)) cat("- **Source:** `", comp$source, "`\n", sep = "")
if (length(comp$dimensions) > 0) cat("- **Dimensions:** ", paste(comp$dimensions, collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")
cat("\n```sql\n", component_sql(cat, id), "\n```\n\n", sep = "")
```

## Data

```{r data}
tab <- data.frame(Period = format(x$period, "%b %Y"), Value = format_value(x$value, m))
names(tab)[2] <- tools::toTitleCase(if (is.null(comp$unit)) "value" else comp$unit)
knitr::kable(tab[nrow(tab):1, ], row.names = FALSE, align = "r")
```
